**Often, yes—but not always.** Bundles can be discounted, but sales on the station or panel separately can erase the savings.

For example, a price check found a BLUETTI AC180 with a 100W panel at **$649 bundled versus $748 separately**—a $99 saving ([PowerSized](https://powersized.com/solar-generator-kits/)). Another comparison found an AC180 + 200W kit **$169 below** the separate store prices, though a discounted station and less-expensive compatible third-party panel could make buying separately cheaper ([Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/solar-generator-kit-vs-buying-separately)).

So compare the bundle against the **exact same station and panel** at current prices, and check that any separate panel’s voltage and connector are compatible.

products: BLUETTI AC180 + 200 W Solar Panel Kit
judge.why: The answer leads with a PowerSized AC180 + 100W example ($649 vs $748), which isn't our listed kit, and uses Dealectric only for a secondary $169 AC180 + 200W comparison.
